QuestInfo.name: [Hayato] Adaptation 1
QuestInfo.0: Motonari has a plan to get you accustomed to the wacky physics here. It probably involves an awesome training montage.
QuestInfo.1: Listen to what Mouri Motonari has to say.
QuestInfo.2: The familiars helped you build up your strength, but you still feel weak. You need more training!

0.0: You will likely find our temporary training grounds lacking, but they are worthy enough to suit your purposes.

yes.0: Perhaps you can prove your usefulness by defeating 10 of my Floateyes in Training Dojo 1.

1.0: So, you've returned. That's a start.

yes.0: You need more training if you're to be of any substantial help towards my cause.

default.0: I thought I had made myself clear. Ten Floateye familiars in the Training Dojo. Go.
